title: BUSINESS STUDIES FORM 1
text:
FORM ONE BUSINESS STUDIES MARKING SCHEME
 1. a)Business- Any activity carried out by an individual or an organisation
 concerning provision of goods and services with the aim of making profit
 b)Business studies-The study of the activities that take place in and around
 production, distribution and consumption of goods and services
 c)Production-Creation of goods and services
 -Increasing the usefulness of goods and services
 d)Commerce-The study of trade and aids to trade (4 mks)
 2. *It is a career subject
 * Equips the members of the society with knowledge and skills necessary to start
 a business
 * Enables individuals to understand the role of government in business activities
 (3 mks, Any other relevant answer)
 3.* Extraction
 *Manufacturing
 *Construction
 *Processing of raw materials (2 mks, Any other relevant answer)
 4. *Legal-political environment
 * Competitive environment
 * Economic environment
 * Technological environment (4 mks, Any other relevant answer)
 5.Human wants are the desires that human beings strive to satisfy using goods and
 services (1 mk)
 6.* They are repetitive
 * They are universal
 *They are habitual
 * They are insatiable (4 mks, Any other relevant answer)
 7. *Goods are tangible while services are intangible
 * Goods can be standardized while services can’t be standardized
 *Goods can be separated from the producer while services cannot be separated
 from the provider (2 mks, Any other relevant answer)
 8.*Human resources
 *Natural resources
 *Man-made resources (2 mks)
 9. Renewable resources are those resources whose supply can be restored after use
 while non-renewable resources are the ones whose supply cannot be restored after
 use , i.e they become exhausted after use (4 mks)
 10.* Comforts
 * Luxuries (2 mks)
